expect_red: dragging the divider LEFT narrows the flyout

mutations.contract: A drag on the flyout's seam keeps working when the pointer moves over the 3D panel. Pointer events over a cross-document iframe go to THAT document, so the panel's own content would otherwise swallow the gesture.
mutations.note: This is the whole bug, not a hardening: measured on the first build of the divider, ONE `pointermove` reached the parent document across an entire 8-step drag and the panel never moved a pixel. The two other drags on this page never met it because neither the grid nor the preview pane embeds a document. The mutation deletes the one rule that fixes it; the LEFTWARD drag is the witness, because that is the direction that takes the pointer over the iframe (rightwards leaves the dialog for ordinary page content and works either way).
